hero.title: Buildora — Construction & Procurement Platform
hero.description: Smart procurement platform: track projects, compare material rates, and trade surplus inventory easily.

how_it_works.heading: How It Works
how_it_works.subtitle: Streamline your site procurement in three simple steps
how_it_works.step1_desc: Set your site details and generate automatic material estimates.
how_it_works.step2_desc: Check live market quotes or purchase surplus items at lower prices.
how_it_works.step3_desc: Verify incoming deliveries, verify approvals, and follow IS codes.

service_groups.main_subtitle: Select a service to start. Protected actions prompt quick sign in.
service_groups.group_a_desc: Manage construction projects and view complete material take-offs.
service_groups.group_b_desc: Get live supplier quotes, check delivered rates, and track receipts.
service_groups.group_c_desc: Buy verified surplus building stock or sell leftover site inventory.
service_groups.group_d_desc: Check IS 456 concrete standards, seismic zones, and natural ventilation.
service_groups.group_e_desc: Monitor future price forecasts and detect unusual supplier billing.
service_groups.card_manage_projects_desc: View active sites, built-up areas, stages, and project schedules.
service_groups.card_boq_desc: Detailed quantities for cement, steel, masonry, and concrete grades.
service_groups.card_cement_steel_desc: Compare supplier quotes for UltraTech, Ambuja, and Tata Tiscon.
service_groups.card_quotes_desc: Review multi-vendor pricing, taxes, freight, and vendor reliability.
service_groups.card_deliveries_desc: Record site deliveries, verify invoices, and update project stock.
service_groups.card_buy_surplus_desc: Purchase good-condition materials at 30-40% discount from nearby yards.
service_groups.card_sell_stock_desc: List your unused rebar, AAC blocks, or tiles for quick local sale.
service_groups.card_is456_desc: Mandatory minimum cement content, water-cement ratios, and curing periods.
service_groups.card_seismic_desc: Inspect local seismic zone, design wind speed, and hazard protections.
service_groups.card_ventilation_desc: Airflow recommendations, window orientations, and thermal comfort.
service_groups.card_price_trends_desc: 30-day forecast curves with confidence bands for key materials.
service_groups.card_price_alerts_desc: Detect unusual rate spikes or billing anomalies with statistical checks.

dashboard.operations_desc: Active site inventory, pending orders, and procurement health across projects.
